related.title: US disables ship in Gulf of Oman under Iran blockade

main.title: Two visions of Spain collide as voters weigh PM Sanchez’s record
main.summary: Socialist PM Sanchez seeks re-election but polls suggest conservative PP and far-right Vox could reach majority.

related.title: What are the main issues driving Spain's national election ?
related.summary: Spain will elect a new government on Sunday in a snap election that could unseat Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The progressive leader has governed Spain for 8 years, presiding over several crises, years of economic expansion and immigration-led population growth. No issue, however, has affected Spaniards during this time as much as unaffordable housing.

related.title: El Guapo’s last gasp?
related.summary: The polls look grim for Pedro Sánchez — but a rightwing coalition won’t be smooth sailing if his opponents triumph

related.title: Immigration, a key issue in Sunday's Spanish snap election
related.summary: Vox has focused its campaign on immigration, which dominated politics after tens of thousands of migrants streamed into Spain's north African city of Ceuta from Morocco in July.

123052f8d3.topic: Spagna al voto: elezioni anticipate, Sánchez rischia contro PP e Vox
